### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in `crypt_tools.c` and `mux_isom.c` are interrelated in that they both deal with the handling of segmented files (sseg) and initialization parameters. The changes in `crypt_tools.c` ensure that when a fragment name is provided, specific parameters are set to manage the fragmented output correctly. In `mux_isom.c`, the logic has been adjusted to only consider `single_file` as false when both `sseg` and `noinit` are true, which aligns with the new parameters being set in `crypt_tools.c`. This suggests a coordinated effort to refine how segmented files are processed and initialized across the two files, likely to fix bugs introduced in a previous commit.
